description: graph-mem embedding benchmark v1 — FR/EN short-fact retrieval with hard negatives. 100 corpus docs across 5 fictional personas (Bruno/Julie/Karim/Lea/Thomas) + 40 queries spanning user_fact, project_fact, temporal, negation, mixed_lang categories. Ground truth is hand-authored.

personas.P1: Bruno — Python/Go backend dev at Michelin, Paris, likes Neo4j, simple architectures
personas.P2: Julie — data scientist, Lyon, PhD in statistics, uses Pandas/DuckDB
personas.P3: Karim — lead SRE, Nantes, Kubernetes bare-metal, bash/Rust
personas.P4: Lea — student intern, Epitech, Python beginner, learning FastAPI
personas.P5: Thomas — tech lead frontend, Bordeaux, TypeScript/Node, pnpm

corpus.text: Bruno uses Python daily for backend development.
Bruno also writes Go for high-throughput services.
Bruno likes Neo4j for graph modeling.
Bruno works at Michelin on the Atlas project.
Bruno is based in Paris and works remotely two days a week.
Bruno prefers simple architectures over microservices.
Bruno used to write Ruby before switching to Python in 2020.
Bruno used to work on Sigma, a legacy project that was decommissioned.
Bruno does not like Java.
Bruno does not work on the mobile app.
Bruno works with Julie on the Atlas data pipeline.
Bruno is coached by Thomas on system design.
Bruno uses VSCode as his main editor.
Bruno runs Docker locally for his dev environments.
Bruno lit Hacker News chaque matin au café avant d'aller au bureau.
Bruno préfère les API REST plutôt que GraphQL pour les nouveaux services.
Bruno ne touche jamais au frontend — c'est l'équipe de Thomas qui s'en occupe.
Bruno a quitté son ancien poste chez Thales en 2020 pour rejoindre Michelin.
Bruno suit les actualités Rust mais ne l'utilise pas au travail.
Bruno thinks PostgreSQL et Neo4j se complètent bien pour le projet Atlas.
Julie is a data scientist at Michelin and holds a PhD in statistics.
Julie uses Pandas and DuckDB for most of her analytics work.
Julie prefers Jupyter notebooks over IDEs for exploration.
Julie works on the Atlas data pipeline alongside Bruno.
Julie also works on Orion, a machine-learning forecasting project.
Julie is based in Lyon and comes to the Paris office once a month.
Julie used R as her primary language until 2022.
Julie does not know Kubernetes and stays away from infra topics.
Julie no longer contributes to Sigma; she stopped in 2021.
Julie mentors Lea on Python fundamentals.
Julie thinks the Atlas schema should use more temporal fields.
Julie apprécie DuckDB en local pour prototyper rapidement.
Julie ne code plus du tout en R depuis son arrivée sur Atlas.
Julie est arrivée à Michelin en 2019 après une thèse sur les séries temporelles.
Julie préfère Polars à Pandas sur les très gros jeux de données.
Julie anime un meetup data science à Lyon tous les deux mois.
Julie has been collaborating with Bruno sur le pipeline Atlas depuis 2022.
Julie does not write Go — she leaves backend services to Bruno.
Julie used to speak at PyData conferences before becoming a team lead.
Julie is currently leading the Orion project for the ML group.
Karim is the lead SRE and runs Kubernetes on bare-metal servers at Michelin.
Karim writes bash scripts for every automation task.
Karim is learning Rust to replace the Python tooling on the infra team.
Karim owns the Atlas infrastructure and the on-call rotation.
Karim does not write application code — he stays in the infra layer.
Karim does not use Python anymore for his internal tooling.
Karim used Puppet until 2021, then moved the whole team to Terraform.
Karim briefly used Ansible in 2019 but dropped it in favor of Terraform.
Karim is based in Nantes and runs the regional ops meetup there.
Karim coaches the infra interns twice a week.
Karim refuse absolument d'utiliser Docker Desktop sur son laptop.
Karim utilise k3s pour ses tests locaux avant toute promotion en production.
Karim n'aime pas du tout les clusters Kubernetes managés des cloud providers.
Karim a coaché Bruno sur les notions réseau en 2023.
Karim tient un blog interne sur les incidents post-mortem d'Atlas.
Karim thinks Rust is worth learning même si la courbe d'apprentissage est raide.
Karim does not work on Orion — ML infra is handled by a separate team.
Karim runs chaos engineering drills on the Atlas cluster every quarter.
Karim used to be a Windows sysadmin before switching to Linux in 2015.
Karim is strongly opposed to Helm charts and prefers raw Kubernetes manifests.
Lea is a second-year student at Epitech doing her first internship at Michelin.
Lea is learning Python as her first serious programming language.
Lea is building a small demo API with FastAPI as her internship project.
Lea does not work on Atlas — her scope is internal tools only.
Lea has never written Java or C# and has no plans to.
Lea is mentored by Julie on data processing basics.
Lea is also mentored by Thomas on TypeScript for the frontend.
Lea is based in the Paris office five days a week as part of her internship.
Lea is interested in machine learning but has not started learning it yet.
Lea préfère écrire ses commentaires en français mais garder les variables en anglais.
Lea a commencé sa formation Epitech en 2024.
Lea n'avait jamais utilisé Git avant son stage à Michelin.
Lea est encadrée par Julie depuis le tout début de son stage.
Lea a choisi FastAPI parce que c'est ce qui se rapproche le plus de Flask.
Lea pense qu'elle voudra faire de la data science plus tard dans sa carrière.
Lea shadows Karim une fois par semaine pour découvrir l'infra.
Lea has been using VSCode from the very first day of her internship.
Lea is not yet allowed to push directly to main on any production repository.
Lea writes Python docstrings in English even though her personal notes are in French.
Lea aimerait apprendre Rust après son stage mais c'est peut-être trop ambitieux.
Thomas is the tech lead for the frontend platform team at Michelin.
Thomas uses TypeScript and Node.js for all production services.
Thomas switched the whole team from npm to pnpm in 2023.
Thomas coaches Bruno on system design every other week.
Thomas also mentors Lea on TypeScript basics.
Thomas works with Julie on integrating the Orion ML frontend.
Thomas used to write a lot of Java back in 2017 but does not touch it anymore.
Thomas is based in Bordeaux and comes to the Paris office twice a month.
Thomas prefers monorepos over polyrepos for all of the team's code.
Thomas does not write Python professionally — he leaves backend work to Bruno.
Thomas rédige un guide interne sur TypeScript pour les nouveaux arrivants.
Thomas préfère les frameworks minimalistes comme Astro ou SolidJS.
Thomas ne touche jamais au pipeline Atlas, c'est le scope de Bruno et Julie.
Thomas a quitté son ancienne startup en 2020 pour rejoindre Michelin.
Thomas organise un book club interne sur les livres d'architecture logicielle.
Thomas thinks TypeScript strict mode est non négociable sur un projet sérieux.
Thomas leads the frontend coaching rotation once per quarter.
Thomas used pnpm well before it was widely adopted in the French Node.js community.
Thomas is an active reviewer on every frontend pull request at Michelin.
Thomas does not attend daily standups — he prefers async written updates.
